title: Canonical pairing from an exterior power of the dual
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and M an R-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and let n be a natural number. Using exterior powers [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], there is a canonical R-linear map from the n-th exterior power of the dual module M^*=\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,R) to the dual of the n-th exterior power of M, whose value on decomposable elements is the determinant pairing.
